Episode Notes:
Nuclear weapons were an important item on the agenda for this week's historic summit with U.S. President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese leader Xi Jinping. Kerry talks with Ankit Panda, host of Thinking the Unthinkable, about the different actors' interests, whether the summit produced anything of value in terms of nuclear arms control or nonproliferation, and what to watch for next.
